other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana.
Pilgrim must complete the Yatra through the State Government, Central Government, or a Society and submit the corresponding completion certificate.
Financial assistance is provided only once per pilgrim.
Application must be submitted within two months of completing the Yatra.
Assistance is limited to a maximum of 50 pilgrims.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹10,000 or 50% of actual expenditure (whichever is lower) per pilgrim, for up to 50 pilgrims.
documents_required: Completion certificate from the State/Central Government/Society
